table.title: Live Spreads Table
table.description: This table shows all currently active arbitrage opportunities detected across exchanges. Each row is a live spread — data refreshes automatically as market conditions change.

opening.title: Opening a Spread
opening.description: Double-click any row (or tap on mobile) to open the full spread detail page with a live chart, order book depth, funding rates, and volatility metrics.

chart.title: Live Price Chart
chart.description: The chart shows real-time price movements for both exchanges. Watch for convergence or divergence — a narrowing spread means the opportunity may be closing.

badges.title: Spread & Volatility Badges
badges.spreadDescription: current profit potential after tariffs. Green = positive, red = negative.
badges.volatilityDescription: recent price fluctuation. Higher volatility = higher risk but potentially faster close.

exchanges.title: Short & Long Exchanges
exchanges.shortDescription: sell (short) the asset here where the price is higher.
exchanges.longDescription: buy (long) the asset here where the price is lower.
exchanges.fundingNote: For funding spreads, the direction also tells you whether you pay or receive the funding rate.

orderBook.title: Order Book Depth
orderBook.description: The order book panels show the top bids (buyers) and asks (sellers) for each exchange. Larger order sizes at your target price mean better liquidity and less slippage when entering the trade.

spreadsPage.errorLoading: Failed to load spreads. Please try again later.

closedDialog.title: Spread Closed
closedDialog.message: This spread has been closed and is no longer available.

spreadPage.tip: Tip: click an exchange name to open its trading page directly.
